name: procedure-etl-conversion
description: Convert SQL Server (T-SQL) and Oracle (PL/SQL) stored-procedure ETL into Snowflake pipelines: toolkit agent etl-extract --etl-platform=procedure parses each procedure body, walks its branches and loops to find the loads, and dialect-translates them with no LLM, emitting one dataspec per target; agent discovery then resolves each against the target warehouse into a data contract, a grouped human-review queue drives those to approved, and agent pipeline-build generates the transforms, tests, and synthetic-data spec. Extraction is deterministic and can run entirely LLM-free. Converts one migration-plan group at a time, or every procedure in one pass when there is no plan.
